scripts.build: npm run build -w @hero-factory/contracts && npm run build -w @hero-factory/api && npm run build -w @hero-factory/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hero-factory/contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @hero-factory/contracts" "npm run dev -w @hero-factory/api" "npm run dev -w @hero-factory/web"
scripts.prepare:codegen: npm run build -w @hero-factory/contracts && npm run db:generate -w @hero-factory/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:codegen && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run prepare:codegen && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run prepare:codegen && npm run test:integration -w @hero-factory/api
scripts.coverage: npm run prepare:codegen && npm run coverage --workspaces --if-present
